subject: tool:composed-census-t15-operand-provenance
value:
A REGISTER_ONLY classification is a statement about ENCODINGS and says NOTHING about which VALUES the two streams read. Every shipped view of game/world/btricol::PointLineDist2D agrees it is REGISTER_ONLY -- webfrank_audit prints `classification: REGISTER_ONLY`, wf_census.classify labels each differing word `regfield`, fndiff --ops reports an identical opcode multiset, wf_word_diff reports CLASS RECOLOR -- while its +0x30 fmul multiplies a DIFFERENT operand pair in each stream (attempt.WC_pointlinedist2d-its-pin-covers-a-reassociated-product-not-a-recolor.20260903.v1). No shipped view asked the operand question, so the misdescription reached a rule note and an unproven_recolor_audit escape. tools/gdl/composed_census/t15_operand_provenance.py asks it: for each differing USE slot it resolves both sides to a VALUE TOKEN and compares.

THE DISCRIMINANT. A register-field-only pair has equal length and the same opcode at every index, so positions correspond. Under a consistent renaming the reaching definition of a read register sits at the SAME index in both streams (the renaming is established at the def, and a bijective position-lockstep map cannot let one stream's value be redefined in between without the other's being redefined at the same index). The screen resolves each use through a CFG reaching-definition fixpoint over webfrank._successors, chases value-preserving copies (mr/fmr/addi rD,rS,0) and li literals, and compares the resulting value expressions recursively to --depth (default 3), treating commutative operand pairs as unordered.

TWO-SIDED CALIBRATION at b8b146891 on a green build, `python tools/gdl/composed_census/t15_operand_provenance.py --calibrate`. POSITIVE side: 1 of 1 -- PointLineDist2D flags OPERAND-VALUE-DIFF, and its first flagged word is +0x30, the word the record names. NEGATIVE side: 79 pinned functions carrying a MACHINE-PROVED recolor (5 value_equality_recolor + 74 strict verify_consistent_recolor), FALSE POSITIVES 0. Exclusions named with their counts: 68 pins declaring a pre-recolor stage (instruction_permutation / equivalent_copy_form / equivalent_mask_form / equivalent_zero_form) are excluded because the build proves those over an intermediate image this screen does not stage -- the five-fold staging-artifact error claim.CE_constant-equality-closure-demand-census-image-wide.20260903.v1 measured -- and 3 pins resting on unproven_recolor_audit are excluded because an inspection escape is not ground truth.

THE NEGATIVE SIDE IS WHAT BUILT THE TOOL, and each refinement is a measured false-positive class. Draft 1 (linear backwards scan, no commutation, index-equality comparison) flagged 139 of 288 paired differing functions and its whole negative set with it. (a) CFG reaching definitions + millicode-preserves-registers + commutation canonicalised INSIDE the value token: 139 -> 16. game/enemy/critter::CritterLineCollide is the CFG case (its r4/r5 webs are defined round the loop the function branches into, so a linear scan calls them incoming parameters) and its prologue `bl _savefpr_26` is the millicode case; game/anim/anim::InitAnim is the nested-commutation case, an exchanged multiply at +0xb0 feeding an exchanged multiply at +0xb4. (b) Three-valued comparison -- a chain that bottoms out at the --depth limit is UNDECIDED, never DIFFERENT: 16 -> 10, and CritterResolveMultipleTargets was flagged only because two otherwise identical chains ended at `insn 13` against `insn 15`. (c) An exchange must swap FORMS crosswise, not match ours-to-ours: 10 -> 9 (game/world/tower::SumnerDoSpeech exchanges two addi that carry two DIFFERENT relocations). (d) Section-symbol relocations normalise to the pool wildcard exactly like @N and lbl_ADDR: 9 -> 4 (our object relocates against `...bss.0`/`...rodata.0` plus an addend where dtk names the datum `lbl_802407B8`; 5 functions moved, incl. game/game/controls::do_vibe).

CENSUS AT b8b146891, 288 paired functions whose raw body differs: PROVENANCE-CONSISTENT 75, NOT-REGISTER-ONLY 174, EXCHANGE 4, BASE-FORM-DIFF 7, UNDECIDED 6, OPERAND-VALUE-DIFF 4, ERROR 18 (webfrank's own fail-closed CFG refusals -- `bctr without discoverable jumptable targets` and `relocated conditional branch` -- reported verbatim, never as a verdict). Of the 4 flagged, 2 are staged-base pins reported as NOT findings (movieplayer::fn_800DBE98, fakelib::sceRead) and 2 are findings: PointLineDist2D, and game/sys/memcard::drawMemCardMessage at +0x1ec -- UNPINNED, and the offset is the one claim.CE_constant-equality-closure-demand-census-image-wide.20260903.v1 records the shipped value-equality relation refusing at, so the screen and the relation agree on the word and this screen adds WHY (the two streams read different values there; note its evidence is an `entry`-component mismatch on a callee-saved register, the weakest of the screen's evidence classes).

SCOPE. Advisory: it refuses nothing and writes no config. WHICH datum a relocation names is deliberately out of scope -- the pool wildcard is the price of not flagging every pool read in the image, and that question belongs to fndiff.datum_multiset_screen and webfrank.verify_datum_binding. The screen is a necessary condition for a recolor, not a sufficient one: PROVENANCE-CONSISTENT means no differing use was shown to read a different value, not that a renaming exists.
